summary: Katapult Holdings filed an 8-K to report that its subsidiary CCF OpCo LLC entered into a Sixth Amendment to its revolving credit agreement with lenders and The Huntington National Bank as administrative agent. The amendment extends the Draw Period Termination Date from August 30, 2026 to September 30, 2026, subject to earlier termination upon an unwaived Cease Funding Event. Upon termination, a twelve-month amortization period begins, with maturity at its end absent default. This is a routine credit facility modification, not a special situation.
